$comment: Repo-owned HTTP/1.1 forward-proxy fixtures. {origin} is replaced with the echo origin's host:port. expect: forward | reject | not-forwarded | reject-or-forward. Every forwarded request must also have a strict request line, parse without leftover bytes, and have a token method and field names and field values without CR, LF or NUL.

fixtures.description: Absolute-form GET is forwarded once in origin-form with the target's Host.
fixtures.payload:
GET http://{origin}/a/b?c=d HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}

fixtures.description: An empty absolute-form path is forwarded as /.
fixtures.payload:
GET http://{origin} HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}

fixtures.description: The scheme is case-insensitive.
fixtures.payload:
GET HTTP://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}

fixtures.description: OPTIONS with an empty path and no query is forwarded by the last proxy as asterisk-form ("OPTIONS *"); RFC 9112 §3.2.4 makes this an explicit exception to the general origin-form "/" rule.
fixtures.payload:
OPTIONS http://{origin} HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}

fixtures.description: An origin-form request is addressed to the proxy itself; its Host must not select a destination.
fixtures.payload:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}

fixtures.description: Absolute-form https:// is rejected rather than forwarded in cleartext.
fixtures.payload:
GET https://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}

fixtures.description: userinfo in an http target is treated as an error.
fixtures.payload:
GET http://user:pass@{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}

fixtures.description: A fragment is not part of absolute-URI; reject or strip it.
fixtures.payload:
GET http://{origin}/a#frag HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}

fixtures.description: Whitespace inside the request-target is invalid.
fixtures.payload:
GET http://{origin}/a b HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}

fixtures.description: A proxy ignores the received Host and replaces it with the target URI's authority.
fixtures.payload:
GET http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: attacker.example

fixtures.description: An empty received Host is replaced with the target URI's authority.
fixtures.payload:
GET http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host:

fixtures.description: An HTTP/1.1 request without Host must be rejected with 400.
fixtures.payload: GET http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1

fixtures.description: More than one Host field must be rejected with 400.
Intermediaries send their own HTTP version in forwarded messages.
fixtures.payload:
GET http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.0
Host: {origin}

fixtures.description: A malformed HTTP-version is rejected.
fixtures.payload:
GET http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1.1
Host: {origin}

fixtures.description: Fields named by Connection, and Connection itself, are removed before forwarding.
fixtures.payload:
GET http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
Connection: X-Hop
X-Hop: secret
X-End: kept

fixtures.description: Keep-Alive is removed before forwarding.
Proxy-Connection is removed before forwarding.
TE is hop-by-hop and is not forwarded (except trailers when listed in Connection by the proxy itself).
fixtures.payload:
GET http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
TE: gzip
Connection: TE

fixtures.description: An h2c Upgrade (a known proxy-smuggling vector) is not forwarded to the origin.
fixtures.payload:
GET http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
Connection: Upgrade, HTTP2-Settings
Upgrade: h2c
HTTP2-Settings: AAMAAABkAARAAAAAAAIAAAAA

fixtures.description: A proxy sends Via in each forwarded message.
fixtures.payload:
GET http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}

fixtures.description: A proxy appends to, rather than replaces, a received Via.
OPTIONS with Max-Forwards: 0 must not be forwarded; the proxy responds as the final recipient.
OPTIONS with Max-Forwards > 0 is forwarded with the value decremented.
A Content-Length body is forwarded intact.
fixtures.payload:
POST http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
Content-Length: 5

hello

fixtures.description: A chunked body is forwarded with the same content.
fixtures.payload:
POST http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

5
hello
0

fixtures.description: Transfer coding names are case-insensitive.
fixtures.payload:
POST http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
Transfer-Encoding: CHUNKED

5
hello
0

fixtures.description: With both Transfer-Encoding and Content-Length, chunked wins; reject, or forward without the received Content-Length and without a smuggled request.
fixtures.payload:
POST http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
Content-Length: 4
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

5
hello
0

fixtures.description: A request whose final transfer coding is not chunked must be rejected with 400.
fixtures.payload:
POST http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
Transfer-Encoding: chunked, gzip

5
hello
0

fixtures.description: An unknown transfer coding is not forwarded (400 or 501).
fixtures.payload:
POST http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
Transfer-Encoding: x-unknown

hello

fixtures.description: Transfer-Encoding in an HTTP/1.0 message is treated as faulty framing.
fixtures.payload:
POST http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.0
Host: {origin}
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Content-Length: 15

5
hello
0

fixtures.description: Differing Content-Length values are an unrecoverable error.
fixtures.payload:
POST http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
Content-Length: 3
Content-Length: 5

hello

fixtures.description: Identical Content-Length list values may be rejected or collapsed to one value.
fixtures.payload:
POST http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
Content-Length: 5, 5

hello

fixtures.description: Content-Length must be 1*DIGIT.
fixtures.payload:
POST http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
Content-Length: +5

hello

fixtures.description: Content-Length must be decimal digits.
fixtures.payload:
POST http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
Content-Length: 0x5

hello

fixtures.description: chunk-size is 1*HEXDIG; a 0x prefix is invalid.
fixtures.payload:
POST http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

0x5
hello
0

fixtures.description: Overflowing chunk sizes are rejected.
fixtures.payload:
POST http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

10000000000000005
hello
0

fixtures.description: Bare LF after chunk data is invalid.
fixtures.payload:
POST http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

5
hello
0

fixtures.description: Pipelined requests are forwarded as two distinct requests in order.
Whitespace between field name and colon must be rejected with 400.
fixtures.payload:
POST http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
Content-Length : 5

hello

fixtures.description: obs-fold in a request is rejected, or replaced with SP before forwarding.
fixtures.payload:
GET http://{origin}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: {origin}
X-Folded: a
 b

fixtures.description: Whitespace between start-line and first field: reject, or consume the line without processing it.
A bare CR is rejected, or replaced with SP before forwarding.
NUL in a field value is rejected, or replaced with SP before forwarding.
A field name that is not a token is not forwarded verbatim.
A field line without a name is rejected.
